cues.text: When morning touched the forest, a little bird named Pip opened his eyes.
The sky looked enormous. His wings felt small. But Pip took the leap.
Over silver rivers, he found that courage could feel a lot like joy.
At the pink lagoon, even the tallest strangers seemed to dance.
Then the sky grew dark. Pip was afraid. Still, he kept flying.
And above the storm, he found the light had never really left.
There were others up here. Little wings, like his, making the same journey.
He had gone looking for the sky. Instead, he found where he belonged.
